title: Add the lockout/tagout class model
stated_need: The lockout story has no classes to hold multi-steps, cues or energy sources.
impact_assessment: Additive; a new parent-step reference re-infers child counts on existing steps.

title: Rename ControlKinds to ControlCategories
stated_need: Control kinds read as hard-coded identifiers.

title: Narrow RoleAssignments.Agent to human or software agents
stated_need: Organizations acting as agents muddle step accountability.
impact_assessment: The plant organization agent's assignment becomes invalid.
implementation_placement: Constrain the Agent reference; keep organization agents in Agents.

title: Declare human and software agents disjoint
stated_need: A person and a program should never be the same agent.

title: Add expected duration properties to procedure versions
stated_need: Stewards cannot compare documented and actual duration.

title: Record the hotfix approval channel for release 2026.07.14
stated_need: Verbal approvals must be findable afterwards.

title: Add an orientation survey class for HR onboarding
stated_need: HR wants first-week orientation survey outcomes in the model.
impact_assessment: Onboarding coverage area has no table.

title: Upgrade change risk classifier 2.4.0 to 2.4.1
stated_need: The patch fixes mis-scored configuration-only changes.

title: Trial risk classifier 2.5.0 in place of 2.4.1
stated_need: The candidate scores database migrations more conservatively.
impact_assessment: One assignment changes; accountability query answers for deploy-02 change.

title: Move production health verification from the health-check AI to the SRE on call
stated_need: The health-check AI missed a partial outage on 2026-03-20.

title: Move night-shift zero-energy verification assist from the plant assistant to the night safety deputy
stated_need: The assistant cannot see a gauge needle flicker.
compliance_impact: The night deputy becomes the attesting person for zero-energy verification under the hazardous energy standard.

title: Add OperatingTemperature to Machines through the bulk loader
Retire the press-7 changeover document-only definition
stated_need: Superseded by the retrofit changeover practice.

title: Add the SMS channel term to the policy vocabulary
stated_need: Channel rules refer to SMS with no controlled term.

title: Restrict procedure version status to PKO statuses
stated_need: Published is not a PKO status; consumers cannot interpret it.

title: Create a lockout variant for mixer 2's twin drive
stated_need: Mixer 2 is on no isolation map.

title: Remove the LegacyStatusCodes class
implementation_placement: Drop the table; re-point legacy rows to LifecycleStatuses.
